evidence: Candidate source keys identify adjacent inspected code only. This index does not establish complete implementation, functional acceptance, or live provider verification.

objectives.objective: Capture an already open ChatGPT thread into VIVIM without sending a new message, and receive a durable local record ID.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Conversation runtime and saved World reader exist; one-command existing-thread intake with durable local record ID is not demonstrated.

objectives.objective: Import a user-selected old thread whose oldest turns are not currently rendered, reporting exactly what history was and was not observed.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Bounded transcript and World coverage expose partial observations; full unrendered historical traversal is not established.

objectives.objective: Refresh a previously saved thread after a new native answer appears without duplicating its earlier turns.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Runtime capture and World records exist; incremental recapture without duplicate earlier turns is not established.

objectives.objective: Import two selected ChatGPT threads into one local workspace while keeping their native thread identities distinct.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: World project membership is present; distinct-thread two-import outcome is not live-verified.

objectives.objective: Recognize and locally preserve a user-edited native answer as a new observed version rather than silently overwriting an older capture.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Bounded visible text observations do not identify native edits or retain a verified version history.

objectives.objective: Capture an assistant's answer while it is still streaming, then mark the eventual completed version separately.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Reply observation exists; separate durable interim/final version preservation is not established.

objectives.objective: Collect an existing thread's visible attachments as references even when their bytes cannot be downloaded.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Visible image presence is a bounded candidate; durable attachment references and download limitations are not proven.

objectives.objective: Save a selected rich answer as locally readable content with text and structured blocks, rather than as a screenshot.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Read-only typed DOM blocks are bounded and may be truncated; selected complete local rich-answer storage is not verified.

objectives.objective: Resume an interrupted local capture from its persisted checkpoint without re-sending the user prompt.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Recovered snapshots are explicitly read-only; resuming an interrupted live capture is not established and sends must not be repeated.

objectives.objective: Show a capture-completeness receipt listing observed turns, missing history, truncated blocks and refused artifacts.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Evidence checkpoint and partial World coverage exist, but full-native-history, truncated blocks and refused assets are not jointly certified.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Trace one locally saved answer back to its exact ChatGPT source thread and native message ID when observable.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Native message IDs are only observed when page attributes expose them; an exact local-to-native message-ID guarantee is unverified.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Distinguish content the provider rendered from a VIVIM-generated title, summary or annotation.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Provider observation and user-authored notes have distinct provenance fields; derived title and summary separation is not end-to-end certified.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Reopen an imported record and see which bytes were captured raw, decoded from protocol or extracted from DOM.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Capture carriers and references exist but a complete user-facing raw/decoded/DOM byte inspection journey is not demonstrated.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Keep two same-text answers from different native threads separate instead of merging on content equality.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Native thread parsing and local IDs exist; preserving distinct same-text answers through two imports is not tested.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Identify that a ChatGPT link changed its visible label while its destination remained the same.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Read-only link label and sanitized URL candidates exist; change history between observations is not stored and compared.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Compare two time-stamped observations of a thread and show what content appeared, disappeared or changed.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Snapshots and evidence timestamps exist; no verified cross-snapshot semantic diff of appeared/removed/edited content.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Explain why a native message cannot be uniquely identified when the page exposes no stable message ID.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Native message ID absence is preserved rather than fabricated; explanatory UI acceptance is still unverified.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Follow an answer's cited URL into a local source-reference record without treating that URL as proof the claim is true.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: A sanitized cited URL and local source-reference primitives exist; citation identity and claim-truth boundaries require proof.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Detect a mismatched source thread during recapture and refuse to append evidence to the wrong local record.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Native thread parsing and runtime binding exist; wrong-thread recapture rejection and no-corrupt-append proof are outstanding.

objectives.section: Source identity, provenance and temporal truth
objectives.objective: Display a provenance chain for a saved answer, including site, session, capture timestamp, extraction method and known gaps.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Source pointers and evidence checkpoints exist; a complete displayed provenance chain with gaps is not demonstrated.

objectives.objective: Create a local VIVIM Project that groups selected saved threads without creating or modifying a remote ChatGPT Project.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: World local project create exists; user acceptance of selected saved-thread grouping without remote effects is unverified.

objectives.objective: Move a locally saved thread between two VIVIM Projects while leaving its remote membership unchanged.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Project membership updates exist but verified two-project move and unchanged remote membership are not demonstrated.

objectives.objective: Attach a personal note to one assistant message without modifying the source conversation.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: User-authored notes and message selections exist; the exact user-visible attachment workflow is not live-verified.

objectives.objective: Tag an answer with a user-defined topic and find the tag on a later visit.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Saved note search exists; a defined user-tag create/filter contract is not established.

objectives.objective: Pin a saved passage as a project reference while the rest of the thread remains unchanged.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Durable selections and project member associations exist; a pin action and its precise saved-passage behavior are unverified.

objectives.objective: Relate a ChatGPT answer to a separately saved article with a user-defined relationship label.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Local source references and relation graph exist; associating an imported article with a specific answer is not proven.

objectives.objective: Split one captured thread into two local collections without changing the underlying message evidence.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Saved conversations and project associations exist; non-destructive local thread splitting is not exposed as a verified operation.

objectives.objective: Merge duplicate local imports of the same canonical thread while preserving observation history.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Import and local record primitives exist; canonical duplicate reconciliation with preserved observation history is unverified.

objectives.objective: Delete a derived summary without deleting its underlying captured evidence.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: World record and note mutations exist; safe deletion of a derived summary without raw evidence deletion is not established.

objectives.objective: Reopen a saved VIVIM Project offline and see the exact previously captured content without an active provider session.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: World reads are local-only; offline reopening of exact content across real process/browser disconnection is not verified.

objectives.objective: Search local ChatGPT captures for an exact phrase and open the matching message, not just the containing thread.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Local message search and part attribution exist; exact phrase hit and native message-level open behavior require real acceptance.

objectives.objective: Find a saved passage using a related concept that does not occur verbatim in its text.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Token-based local search exists; semantic retrieval where query terms are absent is not verified.

objectives.objective: Filter local results to one site, time interval and VIVIM Project simultaneously.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Local corpus filters exist; simultaneous site/time/project filtering with correct exclusion evidence is unverified.

objectives.objective: Search only user-written messages, excluding assistant replies.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Saved messages carry roles; user-only filter in the exposed query needs verification.

objectives.objective: Search only answers containing code blocks of a specified language.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Code language can appear in bounded blocks; exact code-language filter and no-text-leak semantics are unverified.

objectives.objective: Find previously captured tables by a column heading or cell value.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Rich block text can be indexed; table-specific heading/cell targeting and structural fidelity are unverified.

objectives.objective: Locate a saved answer by its cited source domain.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Sanitized source URLs exist; source-domain-only filtering of cited answer URLs is unverified.

objectives.objective: Show which of two conflicting saved statements was observed later without treating recency as correctness.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Observation metadata and local search exist; conflict comparison and timestamp semantics without truth claims are unverified.

objectives.objective: Return search results with source links and freshness/provenance labels rather than unsupported confidence claims.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Search and source-reference metadata exist; freshness/provenance completeness in returned hit cards is not proven.

objectives.objective: Reopen a result with sufficient surrounding thread context to understand the quoted passage.
objectives.firstMissingEvidence: Search hit and saved conversation readers exist; opening a hit with the correct surrounding turns is unverified.

objectives.objective: Select a saved excerpt and prepare a portable context packet without submitting it to any provider.
Preview exactly which original text, references and personal notes a context packet includes.
Remove one sensitive passage from an export preview without altering the underlying local record.
Export a chosen conversation as machine-readable JSON with role boundaries and provenance.
Export a user-selected answer as readable Markdown while preserving code fences and outbound links.
Transfer a selected ChatGPT fact into a fresh provider draft only after the user approves the exact destination and content.
Carry a saved table into an approved form field while retaining local evidence of the originating cells.
Show the difference between a packet staged locally and content that was actually sent to a website.
Revoke a locally issued VIVIM sharing grant and verify subsequent access is denied.
Reimport a VIVIM-exported packet on a different device without losing its canonical source IDs.
Capture one equivalent answer from ChatGPT and Claude as distinct provider observations in the same local project.
Compare responses from two AI webapps without falsely claiming they used identical models or settings.
Resume an existing ChatGPT conversation after inspecting a Gemini tab, without switching send targets.
Discover an unfamiliar site's readable article content without treating it as an AI-chat message.
Read a table from a non-chat webapp using the same typed-block representation as an imported ChatGPT table.
Detect that a ChatGPT composer selector no longer matches and report an adapter-drift reason.
Collect an opt-in DOM evidence sample for a broken UI control without capturing unrelated secrets.
Propose a revised site adapter from observed evidence, clearly marking it unverified until validated.
Compare a candidate adapter against held-out captures before enabling it.
Roll back an adapter update that misclassifies a message role while preserving already captured raw evidence.
